text:
sarah.w: Getting a flood of customer reports that pages didn't hit their oncall after the deploy to vpc-edge-3. Saw a couple of dropped deliveries in the incident logs. Anyone else?
kevin.oncall: saw an alert but never got a phone page. I only got slack channel notifications.
incidentbot: Delivery attempt failed: POST https://pager-proxy.internal/v1/page -> 502 Bad Gateway (x-request-id=3f2a)
dmitri: I can reproduce in staging by toggling the header rewrite flag on pager-proxy. If the proxy strips the X-PAGE-ROUTE header, downstream dedupe kicks in and suppresses a page.
emily.rl: who owns pager-proxy right now? tagging @dmitri but also ops-runbook for playbook.
ops-runbook: Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/paging/issues - follow "Proxy header rewrite" section.
sarah.w: TL;DR: incidentbot tried to hand off pages -> proxy removed X-PAGE-ROUTE -> pager backend thought it was duplicate -> suppressed outbound SMS/phone.
kevin.oncall: is this customer-impacting? which customers?
sarah.w: Affected customers are on Dedicated/VPC (customer A, customer B) where we route via vpc-edge-3. Partial delivery: slack alerts + metrics logged, but no phone/SMS for high-sev pages.
dmitri: temporary workaround: set pager-proxy env PAGING_PRESERVE_HEADERS=true on vpc-edge-3 and restart the proxy. That will preserve X-PAGE-ROUTE.
incidentbot: Automated mitigation attempted: requeueing suppressed pages to fallback proxy -> 5/12 requeued succeeded, 7/12 still suppressed (routing header missing).
kevin.oncall: doing the env patch now. Please put a manual page fallback into the incident channel if any high-sev still silent.
ops-runbook: I'll open a manual page task and notify SRE rotations.
emily.rl: heads up to account teams for customers A/B, sending note.
sarah.w: patch applied to vpc-edge-3 at 1798012560, proxy restarted. Monitoring delivery logs.
pager-proxy-bot: Restart completed (node vpc-edge-3). Preserved headers on outgoing requests.
dmitri: looks like requeued pages are now flowing to pager backend successfully. Confirming: 12/12 delivered after restart.
kevin.oncall: got test call and SMS. can confirm fixed for me.
sarah.w: I'll keep watch for 30m then escalate to postmortem. Please capture deploy that toggled header rewrite.
emily.rl: emailing account reps now.
incidentbot: Incidentnote: temporary mitigation applied, manual pages used for affected customers during window.
ops-runbook: Next steps: (1) revert header-rewrite change in deploy pipeline, (2) add integration test that ensures X-PAGE-ROUTE survives proxy, (3) postmortem with customer impact summary.
dmitri: adding a quick unit/regression test to pager-proxy repo now.
kevin.oncall: leaving a reminder to alert rotation that oncall should manually verify phone/SMS after similar deploys until test added.
sarah.w: thanks all. tagging for follow-ups: @dmitri @ops-runbook @emily.rl.
